comments.text: The title of this video contains the words "The Island America Doesn't Want You To Know About". I spent 35 minutes watching this video, eager to find out who these Americans are who are keeping a secret. During the video, nobody was revealed to be harboring a secret. Instead of exposing a scandal, we were informed about things like native cuisine and local holidays. Whoever came up with this title is clearly attempting to appeal to those who are easily attracted to scandal and conspiracy. Thank you for wasting my time.

replies.author: @MarianasReviews670
replies.text:
You don’t know boring until you live in the Northern most islands of Guam 🇬🇺 you have to live a simple life for a long time to feel comfortable with what you only have which is nature and simple, slow paced life. 
On the other islands there is no movie theater, well known food chains like Burger King, Chili’s, roller coasters, bumper cars and much more that Guam has that the other islands don’t. I live on Saipan further north of Guam and I enjoy the beauty of the islands and the people. It isn’t super modernized like Guam
